patterns.note: Full-width sections with varied background colors create distinct visual breaks, often featuring content centered or split into text-left, image-right arrangements.
A playful, bold sans-serif is used for primary headings, contrasted with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text, and a distinctive rounded display font for the logo and key accents.

A core palette of dark teal, bright yellow, and off-white is consistently used for branding and CTAs, complemented by a rotating set of pastel section background colors (light green, pink, blue-grey) on interior pages.
As the user scrolls, sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect, and the initial transparent navigation bar transforms into a sticky bar with a solid dark background.
Product display sections utilize a grid layout for individual items and bundles, often accompanied by large, high-quality lifestyle photography.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky header that transitions from a transparent overlay on the hero to a solid, dark background with a subtle shadow as the user scrolls down. Scroll-triggered animations, likely powered by locomotive-scroll, reveal new content sections with a gentle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport. The hero section features a full-bleed video background that remains fixed or subtly parallaxes while the overlaying text and calls to action scroll upwards. A modal pop-up appears on page load or after a short delay, offering a discount.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, and playful sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for hero and section titles, complemented by clear, readable body text and small uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and some image containers, with most product cards and content blocks maintaining sharp corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical padding in the hero section and between major content blocks, transitioning to a more balanced density within product grids and feature sections.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its successful blend of high-quality, editorial-style food photography with a playful, almost childlike brand identity, characterized by a unique logo, bright yellow accents, and varied pastel section backgrounds. This creates a premium yet approachable and fun aesthetic that feels fresh for a food brand.
